name: Sugar Beets 2016: Agricultural Robot Multi-Sensor Dataset
description: The Sugar Beets 2016 dataset is a multi-sensor agricultural robotics dataset recorded by the Institute of Geodesy and Geoinformation (IPB) at the University of Bonn and the German Research Foundation (DFG). Recorded across three months during the spring 2016 growing season on a commercial farm in Germany, it captures the autonomous Bonirob field robot navigating through sugar beet fields from the early emergence stage until closed canopy. The dataset features synchronized multi-sensor streams: high-resolution RGB-D images (Kinect v2), 4-channel JAI multi-spectral cameras, 3D LiDAR (Velodyne VLP-16), wheel odometry, and RTK-GPS centimeter-accurate localization tracks, accompanied by pixel-wise ground-truth annotations for crop vs. weed semantic segmentation.
